title: Profit Margin Calculator
description: Calculate profit and profit margin percentage from cost and selling price.

faqs.question: What is profit margin?
faqs.answer: Profit margin = (Profit ÷ Selling Price) × 100 — profit as a percentage of revenue.

faqs.question: Is margin the same as markup?
faqs.answer: No — margin is profit as a percent of selling price; markup is profit as a percent of cost price.
